## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Reference the approved phase and actual requirement or issue identifiers.

## Validation

Record the commands or checks performed and their observed results. Clearly mark checks that were not run and explain material limitations. For documentation-only changes, review links, consistency, and the Git diff.

## Risks and review notes

Describe relevant failure cases, compatibility effects, configuration changes, and remaining work. Include measured evidence when making performance or resilience claims.

## Scope

- [ ] Changes match the approved phase and file scope.
- [ ] Documentation reflects implemented behavior and distinguishes planned work.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed, or unexecuted checks are identified above.
- [ ] No credentials, private configuration, or fabricated results are included.
